Second, Void Shift is not a shield: Riot's passive text is massive damage reduction AND crowd control immunity while he has not recently taken damage, so your Force Pulse slow does nothing until the passive has been stripped by damage.

notes: CHART: full read Skill on rows 2-5 while content read Malzahar on all four. What I did write is supported: the DoT keeps ticking after you disengage.
